annotations.title: Box 3 from 2028: tax on the actual return (plan)

description: The planned new Dutch Box 3 (Wet werkelijk rendement, from 2028): tax on the actual return of the year (interest, dividends, price changes of investments incl. unrealised, rental income, minus interest and costs), compared with today's notional system. A plan; details can still change.

fiscal_partner.description: Fiscal partners (double tax-free amount). Default false.

interest_paid.description: Interest paid on those debts, euros. Default 0.

interest_received.description: Interest received in the year, euros. Default 0.

investments_end.description: The same holdings on 31 December, euros. Default = start.

investments_start.description: Shares, ETFs, crypto on 1 January, euros. Default 0.

net_purchases.description: Bought minus sold during the year, euros. Default 0.

name: box3_2028_actual_return_system
